name: codeintel
description: Deep repository analysis that maintains a local, Git-ignored knowledge base for architecture, debugging, test gaps, change impact, and safe feature work.

interface.shortDescription: Understand any repository deeply and keep that knowledge locally
interface.longDescription: Builds and incrementally maintains an evidence-based .codeintel/ knowledge base covering architecture, components, dependencies, test gaps, findings, and feature-implementation guidance, so future sessions don't rediscover the codebase.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this repository deeply with CodeIntel.
Refresh the project knowledge for my current changes.
